items.title: Show HN: A fun AI project that roasts tech news as COOKING or COOKED
items.summary: Hi HN, so i made a weekend fun project months ago which takes the top 10 tech stories or news from internet, roasts them and categorizes them into cooking or cooked instead of just giving dry summaries. $0 architecture: Github actions runs python script ones a day after extraction the news is news.json then github action updates the page to give us fresh news on frontend. This is open-sourced at https://github.com/pranavworks100/fennec so problem right now is sometimes roasts hit and sometimes they are just bland and generic. so if have ideas to make it even more funnier, please do so :) and another issue is that it sometimes pulls old news from months ago. Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49991917 Points: 1 # Comments: 0
